text.tspan: One preparation. Two independent RHEL applications. Human gates and verified recovery.
Homepage + SSO • AO • AAP + EDA • Developer Hub • Forgejo • Omnigent + Agent Sandbox • GitOps
Show the baseline, trigger the incident, follow the issue and agent, inspect the PR
and tests, approve, then prove recovery.
Both paths require human review and merge. Python also requires AAP production
approval. Agents cannot merge or deploy.
Two production RHEL VMs. Disposable RHEL 9 + 10 virtual test guests.
Management services and agent sandboxes run on OpenShift.
Blue: automation / tests • Amber: operator action or human gate • Green: verified outcome • Detailed paths: pages 02 and 03
